title: Run a small example
summary: docker run creates and starts a container. --rm asks Docker to remove that container after it exits.
introduction: docker run creates and starts a container. --rm asks Docker to remove that container after it exits. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: docker run creates and starts a container. --rm asks Docker to remove that container after it exits.
Docker may download the image, then its small program prints a greeting and exits. The downloaded image can remain locally.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Identify which option removes the exited container.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: --rm removes the container after exit; it does not delete the image.
For more detail later, use this [Docker further reading](https://docs.docker.com/get-started/).

seo.title: Docker: Run a small example
seo.description: Learn about run a small example in Docker. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
